Every `ha-bridge bayesian` command and its help, as `--help` prints it. Each also accepts the [global flags](/commands#global-flags).

## `ha-bridge bayesian`

```text
DESCRIPTION
  Bayesian sensor actions

USAGE
  ha-bridge bayesian <subcommand> [flags]

FLAGS
  --socket string    Path to the bridge socket (default: $HA_BRIDGE_SOCK, then $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/ha-bridge/ha-bridge.sock)
```

## `ha-bridge bayesian reload`

```text
DESCRIPTION
  Reload the bayesian YAML configuration

USAGE
  ha-bridge bayesian reload [flags]

FLAGS
  --socket string    Path to the bridge socket (default: $HA_BRIDGE_SOCK, then $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/ha-bridge/ha-bridge.sock)
```
